data.name: Still Not Dead
data.detailed_description:
Still Not Dead is essentially DOOM + NUCLEAR THRONE..

.. progress through the 6 stages of hell, outrunning death himself and collecting various weaponry and items to survive. Between stages choose blessings and curses to form your playstyle and adapt to each semi-random run. Survive and unlock new skill skulls to ramp up the challenge in the way you choose. Still Not Dead combines frantic action with tactical choice and unique mechanics not seen anywhere else in the genre. Its fast and easy to jump in and start shredding hordes - with depth and variation that reveals itself the deeper into the experience you go. What are you waiting for? Grab your shotgun, axe, barbwire, and prove that you're STILL. NOT. DEAD.


FEATURES:
  • Super fast n' slick gunplay and movement
  • 30+ unique weapons and items
  • 40+ blessings and curses that change the game as you play
  • Skill Skulls to unlock and customise the challenge
  • Fully destructible environments, dynamic fire and weather
  • Massive hordes of monsters for endless combat variation
  • 'Pick up n play' gameplay that evolves into deep and tactical challenge
  • Hand drawn pixel-art and a tripped out pulse-pounder of a soundtrack

data.short_description: Still Not Dead is a challenging roguelite FPS that merges the fast satisfying gunplay of Doom with open stages, insane weaponry, tactical choice and being pursued by death itself. The unique blessing and curse system, plus unlockable skill skulls set the game apart from everything else.

reviews.review:
Still not Dead is a Rogue-Like Outside-Crawler (can't say “Dungeon-Crawler” since every Area is Outside) influenced by Doom.

At First, for me the Game was very Enjoyable.

Albeit very short (6 “Levels”) you get rewarded with a Skull ( Which is very similar with “Clutches” in other Games like Hammerwatch for example ) that make the Game more Difficult the more Skulls you Unlock.

Once you “Beat” the Game, (if you can even call it beaten) all you could do is Achievement Hunting, which i enjoy doing a lot.

And that's when it daunted on me, that this Game is actually very Incomplete / Unfinished.

First, The Game still says “Early Access Update 9” in the Top left Corner which at the time of Writing My Point of View, is NOT stated on the Steam Page of the Game (Red Flag!)

Second, you can’t beat the Game since the Game is in Early Access and you can’t unlock all of the Skulls / Clutches available. (Stuck at 14 Skulls for the Next Level but there are only 13 to choose from)

Third, and my Dealbreaker, you can’t Unlock all the Achievements.
2 of them are bugged (Namely the 3000 Kills and 10.000 Kills) and actually getting 10.000 Gold is pretty much impossible, from what i've Experienced.

I tried around 100 Times and wasn't able to make my “Quota” of Money needed to get to 10K.

You see, when you start the Game, you can choose between 3 Perks, or choose the “Pick for me and get 150P” even with this Option (should you make it with the Perks that the game chooses for you) you won't be able to get to the 2000P that you need per Round to get to 10.000P since there are only 6 Dungeons in total.
Even killing every single Enemy (Which most of the Time only give you 10 early on except you take the Skull with “All Enemies at Level 1” which maybe makes Monsters spawn that could give you 20-30 with Luck) it's still very low even when you consider to get the “Seller Perk” which lets you sell weapons for half the price of what you could buy them, regardless of Ammo.
Buying cheap things and Remix them to Weapons is my Strategy, but even with that the most i got was around 9000.

If the Inventory wouldn't be limited, the Achievement would have been possible.

What i (would have) hoped to see in the Future:

More Levels (Around 10 would be Perfectly Fine)
Finish all the Skulls (or Finish the Game maybe?)
Different Maps (Playing the same “Outside” Maps can be exhausting)
Positive Skulls / Clutches. (To help beginners get into the Game)

Also, sometimes my Mouse Sensitivity randomly Changes, maybe it's just me? But it might be a Bug.

Playing with a Controller kind of Sucks since you can't Customize it well enough to use a D-Pad for example, which i would have preferred. (Not everything is Customizable so to say)

At this point in Time, getting an Unfinished Game for 10€ / 10$ is not at all worth it to me.

Even on Sale, which is mostly around the 2.50 mark, it's still not worth it. (That’s what i've paid for it)

If you Have literally nothing to do (like i did) its ok to get it on a Huge Sale, but Achievo Hunters be warned for its buggy / Impossible Achievements.

People awhile back asked the Developer to fix the Bugs but sadly this won't be the Case anymore since they did not respond since 2018 November with the message:

“Originally posted by Glove Games:
dev is finished on this, project is a mess - unworkable.

if i make a sequel all this will be taken into account, thanks for writing the suggests. ps - molotovs exist “


Message was Originally from the “General Bug Discussion” but has since then been Removed.

If it’s True or not, judging from the Fact how incomplete the Game feels / the missing “Early Access on the Front Page / not being able to beat the Game or get the Achievements / The Message of the Dev and the nice “Early Access” in the Top Corner every time you Start the Game it may as well be True.
